result.summary: PASS. Design correctly scopes to the 6-file public->tenant_default literal fix, provides direct catalog-query evidence for each affected table/index/policy, and explicitly documents why adp09/adp10's failures are NOT covered by this fix (different root causes, confirmed by re-running the full suite twice post-fix and observing adp09/adp10 still fail deterministically with different symptoms). No implementation code present in the design doc -- only WHERE-clause literal before/after and evidence. Classification as Type E is correct: this is not a Type C migration (no migration added/changed) and not a Type A-D parameter-file shape.
